title: A run waiter learns persist_failed only from a mirror file that can't be written for the same reason
outcome: A run wait kept for its verification-record follow-up learns that the host left the record pending (persist_failed or any other reason) from host-owned state, so it resumes even when the run directory's mirror file cannot be written.
acceptance: A run waiter learns persist_failed only from a mirror file that can't be written for the same reason is done
